formal_statement: ∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (fun p => 1 + t p) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ 4) = (Nat.factorial 4 : ℂ)) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ 5
plain_statement: If perm(J_4 + t) = 24 for every t in a complex linear space L of 4 x 4 matrices, then dim L <= 5. With the checked floor L-gct-080 (2n - 3 = 5) it gives LS(4) = 5, the conjecture 2n - 3 at n = 4. Route (seat-barrier-1's n = 3 method): Fourier coordinates over Q(i), M_2 nondegenerate of Witt index 7 on {M_1 = 0}, charts over coordinate isotropic subspaces, Groebner bases on M_3 = M_4 = 0; a Lean proof needs Nullstellensatz cofactors.
title: LS(4) = 5: every linear space of 4 x 4 complex matrices on which perm(J + t) = 24 has dimension at most 5
